scientific_integrity: Integral identity and Jacobian scheme checked symbolically; finite-field enumeration used only as corroboration. No independent audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The complex 2A5 normal form and characteristic-two Hankel determinantal ribbon have antecedents; the proposed contribution is the modular polar-base comparison, particularly the characteristic-three quartic and sixfold intersections. Equivalence under other normal forms is possible.
title: Modular polar-base and singular-scheme trichotomy for the Hankel permanental cubic
